newsitem.title: NORWAY: Statoil, Ruhrgas in gas pipeline cooperation deal.
newsitem.headline: Statoil, Ruhrgas in gas pipeline cooperation deal.

text.p: Den norske stats oljeselskap AS (Statoil) said on Thursday it would sign a collaboration deal with Ruhrgas covering the operation of pipeline systems in northern Germany.
The agreement covers the Dornum-Emden section of Europipe, the line from Emden to the Etzel gas store and the Netra line from Etzel to Wardenburg, Statoil's Status Weekly newsletter said.
Other facilities also included are the receiving station at Dornum and the planned Netra leg from Dornum to Etzel.
John Eldoey, president of Statoil's gas operations in Emden, said the agreement would make more effective and economic use of the lines.

Statoil will be responsible for government relations, technical administration and follow-up of all land-owner rights. Ruhrgas, Germany's largest gas company, will handle technical pipeline maintenance and equipment.
